text:
Maria: Heads-up, seeing elevated retries and ipvs retransmits from gpu-pool-west-2, multiple services hitting 5xx and connection retries
Jin: @Maria can you paste `ipvsadm -l --stats` and `kubectl get endpoints svc/gpu-infer -o wide`?
Maria: pasted below
Maria: ```
IP Virtual Server version 1.2.1
Prot LocalAddress:Port Scheduler Flags
  -> RemoteAddress:Port           Conns/Out/Timeout
TCP  10.12.34.56:443 rr
  -> 10.100.3.21:5000           Conns: 120 Out: 5  Inact: 0
  -> 10.100.3.22:5000           Conns: 8   Out: 0  Inact: 0
  -> 10.100.3.23:5000           Conns: 6   Out: 0  Inact: 0
``` 
Maria: notice heavy skew to 3.21; retried requests show backoff and errors in logs
Alex: sounds like endpoint weight/affinity issue after node reboot
Priya: also seeing RDMA errors on gpu-03: `rxe: peer timeout, resetting` in kern.log
rdma-bot: ALERT gpu-cluster: rxe link flapping detected on nodes gpu-03,gpu-07
netops-bot: interface eth1 on gpu-03 shows intermittent drops: 0.18% packet loss over 5m window
Jin: could be MTU mismatch + RDMA fallback causing some traffic to bypass ipvs h/w path
Maria: checked MTU: gpu-03 eth1 = 1500, others are 9000
Alex: there's the culprit. Jumbo frames off on a subset of nodes -> fragmentation and RDMA errors
Priya: Kube-proxy/ipvs keeps connections sticky to the heavier node and then retries when it gets RST
Maria: I'm going to drain gpu-03 and sync mtu config
sre-oncall: doing canary drain on gpu-03 now, will restart kube-proxy daemonset on the node after config
Jin: while draining, run `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l` and check conntrack explosion
Maria: conntrack was 42k on gpu-03, flushed with `sudo conntrack -F` — logs attached
Maria: after mtu change + conntrack flush + kube-proxy restart, traffic distribution normalizes
Alex: post-fix `ipvsadm -l` shows more even connections: 38/34/33 for the 3 endpoints
Priya: RDMA logs quiet, no rxe resets in last 10m
Maria: retries down from ~22% to 1.8%; latency p90 improved by 120ms
Jin: we'll add an init container to validate MTU at kubelet startup and fail node if mismatch
Priya: filed ENGINFRA-3124 for MTU enforcement + kube-proxy probe, added owners @netops @eng-infra
sre-oncall: recommend runbook entry: if you see endpoint skew + RDMA errors, check MTU -> conntrack -> kube-proxy restart
Maria: also flagging cost impact: extra GPU cycles estimated ~12 GPU-hours (~$1.8k run-rate) this incident window
Alex: nice triage everyone :thumbsup:
Maria: closing thread after follow-up PR and ticket created
